nora: hey team — quick design check on the trace viewer export & header copy. made two variations in Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xxxxx. main asks: export actions order (Export trace / Copy trace link / Copy correlation id), ARIA labels for screen readers, and whether the correlation ID should be inline or collapsed. screenshots attached. PTAL :eyes: alex: looks clean. strong +1 for keeping permalink/trace-link first. Export feels secondary. Can we rename 'Copy correlation ID' to 'Copy correlation ID (full)'? feels clearer when people paste it into bug reports. jamie: runtime note: permalink copy returns the short trace permalink token; correlation id is currently a 64-char hex. UI should truncate visually but copy the full value to clipboard. easy on our side. maria: a11y notes: screen readers currently read the button text only — recommend aria-label include context (e.g., "Copy trace link for selected request"). ensure keyboard focus order matches visual order. also add aria-live region for copy success (role=status, aria-live=polite). sam: from PM POV: prefer order [Copy trace link, Copy correlation id, Export trace]. typical flow is share link -> include id if debugging -> export if you need full trace file. microcopy suggestion: use 'Copy trace link' instead of 'Copy permalink'. nora: noted. two quick Qs: 1) collapse correlation id under kebab vs keep inline truncated? 2) 'Copy trace link' vs 'Copy permalink' — which reads better for external users? alex: I vote 'Copy trace link' — shorter and clearer. For collapse: collapsing reduces clutter but adds one extra click for devs. I prefer inline truncated with full value in aria label. maria: implementation sketch for ARIA: `````` and toast should be announced: `
Correlation ID copied
`. Also add visuallyHidden text for the full id for screen readers. jamie: backend-wise no change needed — the full id is present in the payload. frontend just needs to ensure we copy the full string. I'll add test in the e2e to assert clipboard gets full id. sam: action items: nora update Figma with new action order + 'Copy trace link' microcopy; maria to add ARIA snippets to the a11y doc; jamie/alex to confirm FE PR scope (truncate visually, full clipboard); I'll own shipping this in next sprint. nora: :thumbsup: I'll update and post new frames in 1hr. attaching quick screenshot of reordered actions and keyboard nav notes. ui-bot: Reminder: design QA checklist item added — 'trace export actions keyboard order' alex: small nit — can we make the exported filename include the trace id? `redwood-trace-.json`. Helps support downloads. maria: agree. also ensure the download button has `aria-describedby` linking to a description for screen readers that it's a .json file. sam: perfect — include file naming suggestion in the spec. ok wrapping here, thanks all :raised_hands:
